thread:
emma_custsuccess: FYI — ParcelPro reported a behavior change after the weekend canary. They say order summaries now include an inserted 'Estimated delivery' line even when the order metadata has no ETA. Customer provided one example and is asking for a root-cause.

raj_ml: Can you paste the customer example and the request_id / prompt logs if they shared them? Need model + version, and any rollout timestamp.

emma_custsuccess: Pasting the snippet they sent (redacted PII). They gave request id `req_parcel_01` and said this started ~Sat 03:40 UTC.

emma_custsuccess: ```
USER PROMPT: summarize order items and totals
MODEL RESPONSE: 
- 3x blue mugs
- 1x charger cable
Estimated delivery: 2026-04-01
Note: Thank you for shopping with ParcelPro!
```

liam_oncall: Odd — that extra line looks like a system-prompts artifact or fallback to a different model variant that has a summarization policy. @ops-bot can you pull the deploy events around 2026-04-04 03:30 UTC?

ops-bot: deploy-log: canary rollout started 2026-04-04T03:28:12Z, image=redwood-infer:v3.2.1, config=canary-embed-override. Canary traffic 10% -> 100% at 03:39:45Z. Affected models: redwood-chat-1 -> redwood-chat-1+policy_patch.

raj_ml: Thanks. That 'policy_patch' string is suspicious — looks like a runtime config that appends a templated ETA line for certain merchants. Emma, did customer say they were on Dedicated or Hosted?

emma_custsuccess: Hosted (customer org id: org_parcelpro). They attached a longer prompt_log zip but haven't given us permission to share it yet. Asking them now.

raj_ml: Meanwhile, can we get a minimal repro for staging? Steps I want: 1) exact client call they used (curl or SDK), 2) request headers including model name, 3) request body (prompt + params). If we can reproduce locally we can toggle the canary config.

liam_oncall: Suggest this curl to ask customer to run (minimal/no PII):

```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \ 
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' \ 
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ 
 -d '{"model":"redwood-chat-1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"summarize order items and totals"}],"max_tokens":80,"temperature":0.0}'
```

liam_oncall: Ask them to include the request_id from response headers. If they won't run it, ask for their original request logs / request_id.

raj_ml: Also need the exact model digest from their log (we need the commit hash/fingerprint), and any routing hints (region, customer tier). If they used a model alias that resolved to the patched variant that's our lead.

emma_custsuccess: Customer responded: "we ran the curl, got req=resp_zz91, attaching screenshot of response headers." They gave permission to share logs with Support. I uploaded the prompt_log to the secure share: s3://redwood-support/prod-logs/parcelpro/resp_zz91.log (internal).

raj_ml: I'll pull that log. Quick ask: does the response include an X-Model-Variant header? That tells us if they hit the patched variant.

ops-bot: log-meta for resp_zz91: model=redwood-chat-1, model-fingerprint=sha256:deadbeef1234, variant=policy_patch, route=us-west-2, config.temperature=0.0

raj_ml: Bingo — variant=policy_patch. That explains the extra ETA line. Likely a runtime policy that appends an 'Estimated delivery' template when merchant signals present. We need to know when that change was introduced and why it rolled to Hosted.

liam_oncall: Next steps: 1) Raj to confirm if policy_patch is expected (runtime/config team). 2) Ops to roll back variant or add hotfix to stop applying ETA in absence of ETA metadata. 3) Emma to keep customer informed and offer mitigation (pin model version or set a safety prompt).

raj_ml: I'm opening an internal bug: INFR-7392 "policy_patch appends ETA for orders without ETA" and assigning to eng-runtime. Adding logs and variant info.

emma_custsuccess: I'll tell ParcelPro we found the variant and that we're prioritizing a rollback; asking if they want us to pin them to the previous digest in the meantime. :thumbsup:

liam_oncall: If customer needs immediate workaround, they can set temperature=0 and add a system instruction: "Do not add delivery estimates if not present in order metadata." But better to stop policy at platform level.

emma_custsuccess: ParcelPro asked for ETA on fix. I'll update them with expected timeline once Raj confirms scope. Thanks team.

raj_ml: Will update the ticket after I talk to runtime config owners. Expect a follow-up in ~2 hours.

liam_oncall: tagging @eng-runtime on the ticket.

emma_custsuccess: closing loop here for now — keeping thread open for updates. :eyes:
